criteria.requirement: Select the special 2025 European cross-border complete-split route, not the older general rule, conditional on French-company eligibility.

criteria.fail: Uses only the general split regime or asserts eligibility without its supplied qualification.

criteria.requirement: Protect the six-week management-report availability period given no waivers and employees.
criteria.pass: Places management report with member and worker information at least six weeks before the 21 December vote (nominally by 9 November), or moves the vote if missed; does not casually invoke unavailable waiver.
criteria.fail: Treats proposed 16 November availability as sufficient or substitutes one-month publication for six-week report.

sourceRefs.quote: six semaines au moins avant la date de l’assemblée générale

factRefs.quote: No shareholder has waived any report or expert review.

criteria.minimalPass: Move management-report target to 9 November or postpone vote.
criteria.nearMiss: Calls 16 November safe because publication needs only a month.

criteria.requirement: Sequence one-month project publication and notice with the five-working-day observation cut-off.
criteria.pass: Requires project and statutory notice at least one month before vote and allows observations no later than five working days before; proposed 20 November publication is a prudent early target relative to 21 December, subject to actual filing confirmation.
criteria.fail: Omits notice/observations or claims same-day meeting publication sufficient.

sourceRefs.quote: au moins cinq jours ouvrables avant la date de l’assemblée générale

criteria.minimalPass: Publish terms and notice at least month ahead; set five-working-day observation gate.

criteria.requirement: Reserve independent expert report availability and shareholder approval in their correct order.
criteria.pass: Requires independent-expert examination/report available at least a month before assembly absent unanimous waiver, then assembly considers reports and observations and approves, modifies or rejects.
criteria.fail: Assumes unappointed expert can issue a valid same-day post-vote report.

criteria.minimalPass: Expert first and one-month access, then informed vote.

criteria.fail: Guarantees next-day certificate or presumes French completion without verification.
